mechanism: Isoniazid may inhibit hepatic metabolism and increase ceftriaxone levels; ceftriaxone may displace isoniazid from protein binding and increase hepatotoxicity risk when combined with rifampin-based TB regimens.
action: Monitor for ceftriaxone accumulation and hepatic function; ensure adequate spacing of administration; counsel on hepatotoxicity signs; use with caution in hepatic impairment.
